name: Precipice Loop
why: Strenuous iron-rung climb up the cliffs of Champlain Mountain, descending by the North Ridge. elev_m is from 'rising over 1,000 feet in 0.9 miles', a minimum rather than the total gain.

name: Cadillac North Ridge Trail
quote: The hike is 4.4 miles round trip.
why: Moderate out-and-back on open granite to Cadillac Mountain, the park's highest point.

name: Beehive Loop
why: Short rung-and-ladder loop up exposed cliffs above Sand Beach.

name: Jordan Pond Path
why: Loop around the shore of Jordan Pond; the western half is rougher.

name: Gorham Mountain Loop
why: Rocky loop over Gorham Mountain with coastal views and an optional Cadillac Cliff section with ladders.

name: Ocean Path Trail
quote: The Ocean Path stretches 2.2 miles along Acadia’s coastline.
why: Mostly flat coastal walk from Sand Beach past Thunder Hole to Otter Point, returning by bus. The page says it would otherwise be an out-and-back (7.1 km).

name: Great Head
quote: A longer loop of 1.9 miles is available, as well as a shorter loop of 1.3 miles.
why: Headland loop above Sand Beach; the 1.9 mi loop has a hands-on rock scramble, and the 1.3 mi loop (2.1 km) is more moderate.

name: Bubbles
why: Short climb to North and South Bubble and Bubble Rock above Jordan Pond.

name: Jordan Cliffs Loop
why: Strenuous loop from Jordan Pond across an iron-runged cliff face and up Sargent Mountain.

name: Sargent and Penobscot Mountains from JPH
why: Strenuous round trip from Jordan Pond House over Penobscot and Sargent. NPS gives only a range: 6 mi (9.7 km, used here) to 7 mi (11.3 km).

name: St. Sauveur and Acadia Mountain Loop
why: Challenging west-side loop over two peaks above Somes Sound. The same page also says 'This hike is 3.9 miles round trip.' (6.3 km).

name: Acadia Mountain Loop
why: Moderate-to-steep loop over Acadia Mountain on the quieter west side.

name: Beech Mountain Trail
why: Short, moderate loop to the Beech Mountain fire tower with views of Long Pond.

name: Beech Cliff Trail
why: Short but strenuous ladder climb up the cliffs above Echo Lake, returning by the Canada Cliffs Trail. The page also says 'Elevation Gain: 480 feet.'

name: Gorge/Cadillac Mountain North Ridge Loop
quote: The Gorge Path/North Ridge loop covers a distance of 5.2 miles and climbs 1,086 feet.
why: Moderate-to-strenuous loop up the shaded Gorge Path to Cadillac's summit and down the North Ridge.

name: Pemetic Summit
why: Strenuous bus-supported traverse from Bubble Pond over Pemetic Mountain to Jordan Pond. The page also says 'This trail gains approximately 850 feet in elevation.'

name: Sieur de Monts to Sand Beach Trek
quote: for a 4.1-mile hike made possible by the Island Explorer Bus
why: Strenuous one-way trek from Sieur de Monts over Champlain Mountain to Sand Beach. elev_m is from 'over 900 feet of elevation gain in a 1.2-mile stretch', a minimum.

name: Double Bubble Nubble Loop
quote: Combining these two summits with Conners Nubble will give hikers an exciting 6.6-mile trek
why: Mostly moderate loop from Bubble Pond over South and North Bubble and Conners Nubble, with some rock scrambles.

name: Bubbles Nubble Loop
why: Shorter loop over the Bubbles and Conners Nubble on stepped granite and carriage roads.

name: Jesup Path and Hemlock Path Loop
why: Flat, compact figure-8 walk through the Great Meadow and hemlock forest at Sieur de Monts.

name: Ship Harbor Trail
quote: Ship Harbor Trail is a figure-8 trail covering 1.3 miles.
why: Easy figure-8 coastal walk through spruce forest to the rocky shore on the quiet side.
